headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Pro1 WiFi thermostats (T701 / T705 / T721 / T755). Choose a provider per thermostat: **local** (read-only reachability), **cloud** (AWS IoT, LAN-provisioned, control), or **app** (PRO1 Connect account, control).

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: local = local HTTP API (read-only). cloud = AWS IoT shadow using the device's own certificate (control; briefly interrupts the thermostat's cloud link on every poll). app = PRO1 Connect account over REST (control; no interruption, works off-LAN).

host.title: Host / IP Address
host.description: Thermostat address on the LAN. Required for the local and cloud providers; not used by the app provider.

pollingInterval.title: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: Defaults to 60s (local, app) or 120s (cloud). Minimums are enforced: 15s local, 30s app, 60s cloud — each cloud poll briefly disconnects the thermostat from its own cloud link.

email.title: Email
email.description: Email for the Pro1 app cloud account. Required when provider=app.

password.title: Password
password.description: Stored in Homebridge config; used for Pro1 app cloud login. Required when provider=app.

thingId.title: Thermostat ID (override)
thingId.description: Override thermostat ID; leave blank ('discover') to auto-discover from account. Set this explicitly if the account has more than one thermostat.
